images.evidence: Applied green smb2 filter; status reports 30 packets and 18 displayed (60.0%). Visible requests and responses distinguish the 192.0.2.11 and 192.0.2.10 sessions with 198.51.100.20. Original frame 4 is selected. Approved for this supplemental role only.

Applied smb2.tree contains "ADMIN$" filter displays 10 of 30 frames. Selected original frame 8 shows the TREE_CONNECT request for \\198.51.100.20\ADMIN$; frame 20 shows the candidate request. The view also includes associated responses and file operations, so it is not limited exclusively to TREE_CONNECT requests and does not represent full session coverage.

Applied ip.addr == 192.0.2.10 && ip.addr == 198.51.100.20 filter is bidirectional; status shows 18 of 30 frames. Selected frame 13 is the candidate SYN from port 50102 to 445, followed visibly by SYN/ACK, ACK and SMB2 request/response activity through the file operations. Closing TCP frames and decoded response status are below or outside the visible detail selection; this screenshot alone does not independently establish acceptance or the closing boundary.

Applied frame.number == 22 filter selects original frame 22, a 224-byte CREATE request from 192.0.2.10 to 198.51.100.20. Expanded native CREATE details show filename eca-training-marker.txt and disposition Open If (if file exists open it, else create it). This supports the requested open/create operation, not a successful response or proof that a new file appeared.
